```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

df <- read.csv("~/Downloads/R-Programming-for-Data-Analysts-main/parks_and_rec_budget.csv")
```

### Total Budget by Department

```{r}
df %>%
  group_by(Department) %>%
  summarise(Total_Budget = sum(Budget_in_Thousands, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Department, -Total_Budget),
             y = Total_Budget,
             fill = Department)) +
  geom_col() +
  ggtitle("Total Budget by Department") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

### Annual Budget

```{r}
df %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(Annual_Budget = sum(Budget_in_Thousands, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = Annual_Budget)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  ggtitle("Annual Budget for All Departments") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Budget by Department Over Time

```{r}
df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year,
             y = Budget_in_Thousands,
             color = Department,
             group = Department)) +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Annual Budget by Department") +
  theme_minimal()
```
